listing.name: Gothic II: Night of the Raven (OpenGothic)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Main quest and addon completable according to upstream; desktop prerelease packages. Limits: Upstream says Gothic II plus Night of the Raven completable; Gothic I is not officially supported. Upstream platforms: Windows DX12/Vulkan, Linux Vulkan and macOS Metal package/build routes documented. Selected package CPU architectures unknown; Windows-only32-bit Union plugins are unsupported. Original data: Gothic I explicitly not officially supported; original Gothic II Night of the Raven files needed. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
listing.original_game_title: Gothic II: Night of the Raven

steps.title: Prepare the Night of the Raven runtime and data
steps.instruction: Use a complete permitted OpenGothic Windows copy and your own Gothic II: Night of the Raven data. Select native Gothic2Notr.exe with its matching resources/libraries. Gothic I, Gothic II Classic and existing 32-bit Union/AST/Ikarus plugins do not inherit compatibility from this route. Finish setup upstream rather than selecting an installer or a helper.

steps.title: Preserve the actual working directory as well as game data
steps.instruction: Retain the creating working directory and established literal -g argument pointing to the actual absolute Gothic II data root, if used. Automatic discovery is not a reason to change a working data selection. The selected Windows code uses working-directory Gothic.ini and log.txt, separately from original System/Gothic.ini, and writes save_slot_0.sav/save_slot_N.sav relative to the working directory. Preserve the complete creating working directory, actual original-data root, every save/config/mod and unknown file; do not assume the original vendor save directory contains all OpenGothic state.

steps.title: Check the working copy before registration
steps.instruction: Finish upstream setup and a normal start/quit using the intended copy before attaching it. Retain its exact native executable, working directory and established supported literal arguments. Review the selected intent and consent, then choose Play separately. Attaching a copy does not certify the game, its original assets or its save compatibility.

steps.title: Keep updates and removal under the existing owner
steps.instruction: Close all actual game instances before changing files. Keep the old creating runtime and every actual data/profile root recoverable, make deliberate compatible updates upstream, then review/relink a changed executable before the next Play. Upstream/player owns preparation, updates, writes, migration and recovery. Portcove supervises its selected process; this is not an exclusive instance lock or a sandbox. Removing this registration preserves external files. This route does not offer Portcove-managed downloads, setup, updates, backup, rollback, migration or external-file deletion.

warnings: Use only a copy and content you are already permitted to use. Engine licensing does not grant rights to original game assets, music, mods or bundled components.
Preserve every actual external runtime and player-data location before upstream changes. Shared profiles are not isolated by choosing a different executable.
